en.t: General Genji came to pay his New Year respects.

units.source_text: 但见四周毫无新年气象，宫中人影稀少，肃静无声。

en.t: Yet all around there was no sign of New Year festivity; the palace was sparsely peopled, solemn, and silent.

units.source_text: 只有几个亲近的当差宫女低头坐着，恐是心情所使然，似有不胜委屈之感。

en.t: Only a few close ladies-in-waiting on duty sat with their heads lowered, and perhaps because of their mood, they seemed overcome with a sense of grievance.

units.source_text: 只有正月初七举行白马节会时，白马照旧到这宫邸来，侍女们可以观览。

en.t: Only on the seventh day of the first month, when the White Horse festival was held, did the white horses come to this palace as usual, allowing the maidservants to view them.

units.source_text: 往年每逢新春，必有无数王侯公卿到这三条宫邸来贺年，门庭若市。

en.t: In past years, every New Year countless princes, nobles, and court ministers came to the Sanjo palace to offer greetings, and the gate was as crowded as a marketplace.

units.source_text: 但今年这些人过门不入，大家麕集在右大臣府中了。

en.t: But this year those people passed by the gate without entering, and all gathered instead at the Minister of the Right's residence.
The fickleness and coldness of the world were deeply lamentable.

units.source_text: 正当此时，源氏大将以英爽之姿，专诚来访，真可以一当千，邸内诸人不禁感激涕零。

en.t: Just then, General Genji came in his splendid and gallant bearing, making a special visit; he was truly worth a thousand guests, and everyone in the residence could not help shedding tears of gratitude.
